title: NEXUS — BBP lanes and SHA-256 round compiled in difference coordinates

engine.definition: a_S = XOR_{T subset S} f(T) = (product_{i in S} D_i f)(0)
engine.implementation: equal-LEN first-run stack; fuse (A,B)->(A,A XOR B)
engine.involution: M(M(f)) = f over every finite Boolean-cube table compiled
engine.interpretation: difference coefficients are used as executable ANF terms at BBP lane addresses and in each local SHA gate

bbp.global_carry_scope: finite stack with N=64 reported fractional digits and G=12 guard layers; not the per-layer J_k carry

sha256.state_dimension_note: Each table is the exact restriction of the actual round/compression map to the LEN=8 affine subspace formed by flipping bit 0 in each of the eight 32-bit state words. The full SHA domain is composed from compiled local operators; its 2^256-state truth table is not enumerated.
sha256.observer_limit: Inverse round route uses known W[t], K[t]. Feed-forward is reversed with incoming H retained. This is not a digest-only message inverse.

ledger.full 256-bit SHA truth-table enumeration: not attempted; replaced by exact composition of compiled local transformations
